notes.title: Twitch Mode Release
notes.content:
Hey guys, it's been a while right?!
Well after a long testing and development session we have completed the first major content update.
And we are proud to announce the awaited Twitch Mode!!

In this mode you will play Blow Up Pieces like never before!! Think you are an avid player? Now you can truly put that title to the test.
In this mode you can play the game just like it was another Singleplayer session but this time all your viewers can vote on various ways to either help you or to screw you at regularly announce events.

Once you start this mode you will notice our cadet Mike Bah-Gawsky joins your twitch stream, he will be the event announcer, count the votes you receive and when the time comes pass his sentence upon you. Good luck!

- - - - -

The following change-log shows the fixes and implementations done to the latest version of Blow Up Pieces: Unleashed:

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Twitch Mode
[*] Reworked all menus to assume B as back rather than show a button saying back
[*] Changed entire button navigation structure to allow for better menu control
[*] Changed menu button assigning to only work when using a controller, Buttons/Toggles/Dropdowns should no longer auto-select when changing menus when using mouse and keyboard
[*] Reworked Market Menu navigation, all purchase buttons are now navigationable even when player doesn't have enough money or has max quantity, rather than turning un-selectable
[*] Reworked Consumable Selection Menu, all consumables are now shown, but will only be selectable if the player has 1 or more
[*] Added new content to the Main Menu tutorial
[/list]

[b]INTERFACE:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a B to back visual aid to all Menus when using controller
[*] Main menu now shows the current version
[/list]
